Dear Ms. Ortiz,

Re: Statute of Limitations Dispute

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you have raised concerns regarding the statute of limitations on this account. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a validation notice within five days of our initial communication. However, we have no record of any prior validation request from you. We will provide you with a validation notice as required by law.

Regarding your concerns about the reporting of this account, we will investigate the discrepancies you have raised regarding the reporting of the account status with the credit bureaus. However, we must clarify that the statute of limitations is a matter of state law, and we will review the applicable New Mexico statute of limitations for this account.

We will investigate your dispute and provide a response within 30 days as required by the FDCPA. If we determine that the account is indeed past the statute of limitations, we will take the necessary steps to cease collection efforts.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this account further if you believe that additional information is necessary to resolve this matter. We encourage you to review our investigation results and respond to us if you have any further concerns.

Sincerely,

Crestview Financial Recovery
